title: metadata-admin: a permission set's Assigned users list prints the position's machine name ("via position sales_rep" / 「经岗位 sales_rep」); show its label, which objectstack now serves localized (objectstack#25701)
body:
Filing gate **③, a follow-up owed by a landed change**: the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25652, landed in objectstack-ai/objectstack#25701. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT`. The seat committed in its ACCEPT to file this card, scoped to the render sites that remain once the server serves these labels localized. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What landed upstream

objectstack-ai/objectstack#25701 (merged `47af3dde42`) makes positions and permission sets translatable:
- `positions.<name>` / `permissions.<name>` groups (`label`, `description`) in the translation bundle;
- `translatePosition` / `translatePermissionSet` registered in the metadata-document translators.

So `GET /meta/position` and `GET /meta/permission` (list and item) are now served in the request's locale. Every console surface that takes a position's or permission set's label **from those lists** shows the translated label with no objectui change. The motivating producer is hotsrm, which ships Chinese-authored positions with an English bundle (hotsrm#22).

## Measured on objectui `main` `a3c0da9227`

**Already reads the label from the `/meta` lists (nothing to do):**
- `AccessExplainPanel` `CitedItemChip`: principal positions and permission sets, plus each layer's "Contributed by" chips. The label comes through `lookUpItemLabels` from the metadata store.
- `useApproverDirectory`: the registry label leg reads the metadata store.

**Prints the machine name:**
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx:543` renders `c.viaPosition(v.position)`. Here `v.position` is the raw `sys_user_position.position` value (`:348`), and the copy is `'via position ' + p` (`:180`) / `'经岗位 ' + p` (`:154`). A holder row therefore reads "via position srm_legal_counsel" in every locale, even though the same section already loads the position list through `ensureType('position')` (`:320`).

## The ask

- In `AssignedUsersSection`, render the position's label from the position list the section already loads, keeping the name on `title` the way `CitedItemChip` does. Fall back to the name when no label resolves.
- **Sweep, measure first:** find any other site that renders a position or permission-set name from a payload other than the `/meta/position` / `/meta/permission` lists. Candidates to check: the position holders section, the approvals inbox's approver `type: 'position'` rows (`apps/console/src/services/approvalsApi.ts:146`), and the sharing-rule `sharedWith` position display. Fix the ones that print a raw name the same way. Report the ones that already read a label.
- Confirm the metadata store's `/meta/position` and `/meta/permission` reads carry the user's locale, so the server overlay applies. If they do not, that gap is the first fix.

## Dedupe

Semantic search in objectstack-ai/objectui, "position permission set label translated localized assigned users via position raw name": 1 hit, #13304 (closed; `PositionPreview` and `permissionSets`, a different surface). **New.**
